 KATHMANDU: Kathmandu Gorkhas and Janakpur Bolts will face off in the only match of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) scheduled for Tuesday.
 Sudurpaschim Royals won the toss in the match being played at the TU International Cricket Stadium. Their captain, Dipendra Singh Airee, elected to bat first.
 Sudurpaschim are currently third in the league standings with six points, while Janakpur Bolts sit in fifth place with four points.
